category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
scenario_title: Initial storytelling session with physical books
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group storytelling session where they are expected to listen to a physical storybook being read and act it out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please gather around. I am going to hold this storybook and read it to you, and I want you to listen and act it out with me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do we have to be away from our classroom? I want to return to my own classroom to do the homework I was supposed to finish.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to stay here for the story right now. Let's begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I simply do not like English, no matter what you do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just give it a try. Look at the book while I read and act out this first part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Completely ignores the storyteller and starts playing with a pencil and strips of paper) This story is boring! (Stands up and starts running around the room)
